excerpts.text: The study followed adult shift workers in one hospital. It reported an association between schedule regularity and self-reported sleep quality. It did not test an intervention.
This chapter describes Region A school council rules in force in 2009. Each council includes two elected teacher representatives.
Use classification to group objects by shared properties. Sorting seashells by shape is one example; the same approach can organize other collections.
In the narrative interview method described here, the interviewer begins with one open question and lets the participant finish their account before asking follow-up questions.
In this exercise, lengths are given in feet and areas in square feet. Keep these units consistent when comparing the plot dimensions.
